specs.title: structured notes autosave; others see them live as read-only; the host grants edit access; different sections merge
offline edits are kept and saved when the connection returns; version history, restore, template and export work
after the meeting ends, participants can still read the notes but nobody can change them
host launches a poll from the UI; one vote each; results stay hidden until published; closing and publishing show everyone
every poll type validates on the server; anonymous ballots are not tied to names; quiz feedback; drafts are private; timed polls close by themselves; CSV export is host-only and safe
the poll form works by keyboard and shows only the fields the chosen type needs
tools are grouped in expandable sections; unavailable tools are labelled, not faked; real tools work
G1-01/02: two real browsers exchange audio and video; mute and camera-off act on the real tracks
G1-03/04/07: a lost connection is shown as lost (never Live), recovers on its own, media resumes, no duplicate participants
G1-05 (ICE restart path only): a peer connection that is told to recover restarts ICE and keeps media flowing
G1-06: leaving or ending the meeting closes the peer connections, signalling and local devices
launch parameters (name, passcode) are removed from the address bar once used
the toolbar uses compact standard-size controls, all visible, with Record in the bar
screen share never mirrors itself: this tab is excluded, your own share is a placeholder, others see the real screen
the video page fits the window with nothing to scroll: 1 to 4 people, every layout, several window sizes, and while sharing

suites.title: Qorlla Meet G2 interface and accessibility

specs.title: desktop: panel and video side by side; the panel collapses, expands and is resizable by keyboard
the panel can be docked left / right / top / bottom (buttons or dragging), resized in any dock, and locked in place
tablet: video first, the panel is a drawer that opens on demand, traps nothing, closes on Escape / scrim and returns focus
mobile: compact controls with a More menu, bottom-sheet panel, nothing scrolls sideways, also at 320px (reflow)
keyboard: shortcuts work, never fire while typing, can be switched off, and the dialog traps focus, closes on Escape and restores focus
screen-reader semantics: tabs, names for every control, connection changes announced once, state not by colour alone, accessible confirmations
host controls: End for all is an accessible confirmation (Escape and Cancel keep the meeting), guests do not get it
the consent question cannot be dismissed with Escape (Agree or Decline is required) but is keyboard-operable
request -> notice -> everyone agrees -> start; a late joiner pauses it until they answer; stop saves a real file; the next request needs fresh consent
one decline blocks recording and the decliner can stay or leave; withdrawing consent mid-recording stops it and saves what was captured
a brief host disconnect does not finalize the recording (audited); an outage past the grace period does; leaving on purpose stops it at once
only the host can request, start or stop; nothing starts without a request; disclosure and the privacy contact are mandatory

suites.title: v4.0.3 recording compliance and secure storage (R01-R18)

specs.title: R01-R03: notice with enforced retention, refusal leaves nothing behind, no media accepted before authorization
R04: a late joiner is neither recorded nor accepted into the recording until they consent
R04b: the recorder leaves out anyone who has not consented (picture and sound), whatever the server timing
R05: withdrawal stops acceptance at once; what was captured while everyone consented is kept, byte for byte
R06: AI consent is separate from recording consent, per purpose, append-only and never implied
R07: media is encrypted at rest (no plaintext on disk), authenticated, and tampering is detected and audited
R08-R09: only the host gets short-lived single-use links; guests, other meetings, bad and expired links are refused; every access is audited
R10: retention expires on schedule - media erased, key shredded, link gone, audited
R11: the host can delete: storage is cleaned, the key is gone, others cannot, a running recording cannot be deleted
R12: legal hold blocks deletion and retention expiry until released (admin-only)
R13: a recorder that disappears mid-recording is recovered: what was received is finalized, flagged partial, and still decrypts
R14: the real recorder survives an upload outage: queued chunks are retried in order, nothing is lost or duplicated
R15: finalization that never completes is finished by the server (no stuck recordings)
R16: concurrent requests - exactly one recording request and one start win
R17: unauthorized upload and malformed input are refused
R18: the audit trail is complete, ordered and hash-chained; guests cannot read it
